name: Identifiable Victim Effect
definition: An identified individual elicits more help than comparable anonymous beneficiaries.
boundary: Identification must drive the difference; differing effectiveness can justify allocation.

source_variants.name: Identifiable Victim Effect (Belirlenebilir mağdur etkisi)
source_variants.definition: Reacting far more strongly to one named victim than to a statistical group.
source_variants.coverage_reason: No named mechanism, required state or observation model is implemented in the original Mesa sample.
